 At RTX, the world largest aerospace and defense company, 185,000 great minds are united by purpose and inspired to make a difference solving the world’s most complex problems. With our three market leading businesses, world-class operations and investments in research and development, we offer capabilities and opportunity no one else can. Together, we push the boundaries of known science and find new ways to connect and protect our world.
 
 Pratt & Whitney is a world leader in the design, manufacture and service of aircraft engines and auxiliary power systems and has been revolutionizing modern flight for over 100 years. Join us and help shape the future of aerospace and defense.
 
 What You Will Do 
 Pratt & Whitney seeks a motivated and detail-oriented Engineer II to support the Engine Design & Systems Integration (EDSI) area. The EDSI organization is a multi-functional group that provides system-level engineering solutions to meet customer requirements.
 The F135 Engine Design and System Integration (EDSI) Production and Field Support Team is seeking a Data Engineer.  In this role, the candidate will have responsibility for ensuring that the Life Management Table architecture supports integration with the downstream system and is maintained to VAULTIS standards.  The candidate will work at the direction of the lead architect to expand database features, ensuring part tracking and life management information is maintained and flowed to downstream systems.   The candidate will query enterprise data systems to ensure integration with sustainment data products.  The candidate will be responsible for identifying cross-system data misalignment, driving data management process change, and automating the detection of process failure modes to ensure engineering intent is maintained across the F135 sustainment enterprise.  This role requires integration with internal component groups (CIPT),  Model-Based Systems Engineering, and PW Sustainment organizations.
 Understand F135 Data Investigation team lessons learned

 Participate in Sustainment integration meetings and derive requirements for feature definition

 Maintain & continuously improve database features and data integration solutions (data pipelines & API endpoints)

 Support development & optimization of data models, database schemas, and data storage solutions

 Monitor data quality measures, collaborating with adjacent engineering & sustainment teams to ensure data accuracy & completeness

 Test database & data integration features and present results to ensure design intent to requirements

 Generate technical documentation, presentations, and reports to communicate results, risks, and recommendations to engineering teams and leadership.

 Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance our tools, analysis methodologies, and workflows.

 Based on business needs, the incumbent may be required to support other duties/functions within the company.

 English (read, write, speak) is required when communicating with customers, co-workers, or supervisors who only speak English.

 Travel is up to 15%.

 
 Qualifications You Must Have 
 Bachelor's Degree in Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM)

 2 years of engineering experience, or an Advanced Degree with a GPA of 3.0 or higher

 Experience with coding

 
 Qualifications We Prefer 
 Experience using Databricks, Python & SQL

 Experience using Flask, Node.js, or equivalent web application frameworks

 Experience in F135 fleet sustainment or F135 data systems

 Knowledge of gas turbine engine fundamentals, with emphasis on engine propulsion and component matching analyses. 

 Familiarity with agile development methods 

 Demonstrated implementation of data management solutions to integrate and optimize pre-existing infrastructure

 Communication and teamwork abilities to work within a multidisciplinary environment.

 Knowledge in Data Analytics, Machine Learning, and/or Model-Based System Engineering.

 Works autonomously with limited supervision.

 
 What We Offer: 
 Employee Scholar Program

 
 Learn More & Apply Now! 
 The EDSI Commercial Engines and Military Engines organizations are focused on delivering systems solutions to meet customer requirements, driving engineering quality and productivity, and developing the next generation if systems engineers.​​ EDSI is responsible for the integration of components, modules, and sub-systems into world class commercial and military propulsion systems.​​

 
 What Is My Role Type: In addition to transforming the future of flight, we are also transforming how and where we work. We’ve introduced role types to help you understand how you will operate in our blended work environment. This role is:
 In addition to transforming the future of flight, we are also transforming how and where we work. We’ve introduced role types to help you understand how you will operate in our blended work environment. This role is:
 Hybrid: Employees who are working in Hybrid roles will work regularly both onsite and offsite. Ratio of time working onsite will be determined in partnership with your leader.

 
 Candidates will learn more about role type and current site status throughout the recruiting process. For onsite and hybrid roles, commuting to and from the assigned site is the employee’s personal responsibility. 
 
 
 
 
 RTX is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability or veteran status, or any other applicable state or federal protected class. RTX provides affirmative action in employment for qualified Individuals with a Disability and Protected Veterans in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act and the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act.
